description: This file defines a Buffer class and a BufferQueue class for managing a queue of Buffer objects, with thread synchronization mechanisms including mutex and semaphores. It appears to be used for managing audio buffers in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer with data and length, providing methods to fill, retrieve, and delete the buffer.

classes.name: BufferQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe queue managing Buffer objects using mutex and semaphores, supporting add, remove, clear, and status checks.

methods.name: Buffer::fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills the buffer with data from a given pointer.

methods.name: Buffer::getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the buffer.

methods.name: Buffer::getBuffer
methods.description: Returns the pointer to the buffer data.

methods.name: Buffer::deleteBuffer
methods.description: Deletes the buffer data to free memory.

methods.name: BufferQueue::add
methods.description: Adds a Buffer object to the queue.

methods.name: BufferQueue::remove
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest Buffer object from the queue.

methods.name: BufferQueue::BufferQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BufferQueue with a specified size.

methods.name: BufferQueue::isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer queue is empty.

methods.name: BufferQueue::isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer queue is full.

methods.name: BufferQueue::clear
methods.description: Clears all buffers from the queue.

methods.name: BufferQueue::preDelete
methods.description: Prepares the buffer queue for deletion, potentially by cleaning up resources.

methods.name: BufferQueue::count
methods.description: Returns the number of buffers currently in the queue.

methods.name: BufferQueue::~BufferQueue
methods.description: Destructor freeing resources associated with the buffer queue.
